summary: Lantheus filed an 8-K updating litigation around its pending merger with Curium US Holdings LLC under an August 3, 2026 agreement; Merger Sub will merge into Lantheus, which survives as a wholly owned Curium subsidiary. A special meeting is set for October 14, 2026 to vote on the merger and related proposals. Three stockholder complaints filed September 16 and September 25, plus sixteen demand letters, allege proxy omissions on projections, Morgan Stanley's fairness analysis and insider conflicts, seeking injunctive disclosure relief. Watch the vote outcome, any settlement disclosure supplement and closing conditions.
